    for name,e in errs.items():
        slices=[labs==j for j in np.unique(labs)]+[missing,~missing]
        score=lambda x:np.array([np.sqrt(np.mean(x[:,:-1]**2)),np.sqrt(np.mean(x[:,-1]**2))])
        print(label,name,'overall strain/rate RMSE',score(e).round(5),'worst slice',np.max([score(e[s]) for s in slices if s.any()],axis=0).round(5),'median abs',np.r_[np.median(abs(e[:,:-1])),np.median(abs(e[:,-1]))].round(5))
